newsitem.title: USA: Yahoo to carry Motley Fool investor forum.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo to carry Motley Fool investor forum.

text.p: Yahoo! Inc said Wednesday it had formed a partnership with Motley Fool Inc, a popular online investor site formerly available exclusively from America Online Inc.
Yahoo said the Motley Fool forum will appear free of charge to users of its Web site.
The company said it has integrated Motley Fool content into Yahoo's investor information section, which includes portfolio management, stock charting, company profiles, news and stock quotes.
